audience: dispatch teams that plan delivery and collection jobs in Detrack

useCases.title: Find failed deliveries and the reason for each
useCases.text: Search jobs by date range, status or reason, for example for failed deliveries. List the jobs of a day to see the full list.

useCases.title: Check one job and the routes for its date
useCases.text: Get a job by its DO number, or by DO number and date. List the routes planned for that date.

useCases.title: Create a delivery or collection job
useCases.text: Create one job for a date. An existing DO number on the same date is not overwritten.

useCases.title: Update the details of a job
useCases.text: Change only the fields you pass for one job, found by its DO number. Completed jobs may refuse the change.

useCases.title: Delete a job that was created by mistake
useCases.text: Check the job by DO number and date first. The delete is permanent, so confirm the right job before you remove it.
